title: Software Developer
description: Researches, analyzes and evaluates requirements for software applications and operating systems; designs, develops, tests and maintains software solutions.
tasks: Writing code in Python, Java, SQL, developing REST APIs, automating test workflows, implementing cloud infrastructure and continuous deployment pipelines.
mycol_evidence: TalentCorp MyMahir 2024/2025: Critical shortage across fintech, digital health, and smart manufacturing.

title: Systems Analyst & Process Automation Architect
description: Analyzes user requests, requirements, and problems to optimize process flows and orchestrate business operations with digital tools.
tasks: Business process mapping (BPMN), standard operating procedure (SOP) formalization, robotic and AI workflow orchestration, human-in-the-loop validation.
mycol_evidence: Surge in corporate process automation under Malaysia Digital Economy Blueprint.

title: Database Designer & Administrator
description: Designs, implements, and maintains database management systems ensuring security, data integrity, and performant querying.
tasks: Structured Query Language (SQL) optimization, relational data modeling, data pipeline orchestration, data privacy and PDPA access controls.
mycol_evidence: Critical role across government agency modernization and e-commerce.

title: Environmental & Sustainability Specialist
description: Conducts environmental audits, GHG carbon accounting, and sustainability compliance reporting for organizations.
tasks: ESG reporting (Bursa Malaysia Sustainability Guidelines), carbon footprint modeling, Scope 1-3 emissions data visualization, environmental impact assessment.
mycol_evidence: National Energy Transition Roadmap (NETR) and Bursa Malaysia mandatory ESG disclosure requirements.

title: Policy & Governance Compliance Officer
description: Develops, oversees, and audits organizational compliance with regulatory policies, ethical guidelines, and statutory laws.
tasks: AI ethics auditing, bias mitigation assessment, personal data protection (PDPA 2010 compliance), risk assessment frameworks, model performance review.
mycol_evidence: MOSTI National AI Office (NAIO) launch and National AI Governance and Ethics (AIGE) guidelines.

title: Training and Workforce Development Professional
description: Designs and delivers instructional curricula, organizational change programs, and digital reskilling interventions.
tasks: Instructional design, AI literacy workshop facilitation, learning analytics, change management, employee capability benchmarking.
mycol_evidence: HRD Corp National Training Index: Urgent need for AI transition trainers.

title: Quality Assurance & Software Tester
description: Executes test scenarios, identifies bugs, assesses algorithmic reliability, and ensures conformance to product specifications.
tasks: Automated test suite maintenance, human-in-the-loop quality evaluation, edge-case synthetic data verification, API endpoint testing.
mycol_evidence: High demand for AI QA and prompt evaluation in software development houses.

title: General Office & Clerical Assistant (Routine Tasks)
description: Performs clerical tasks in accordance with established procedures: photocopying, document sorting, manual filing.
tasks: Physical document collation, paper invoice data entry, sorting incoming mail, routine typing without modern automation software.
mycol_evidence: High automation displacement risk as projected in Hays Asia 2025 and MOSTI 600,000 reskilling forecast.

title: Data Entry Clerk (Repetitive Manual Processing)
description: Enters numerical and text information from source documents into computer databases using standard keyboard.
tasks: Manual data transcription, keying survey records, checking paper forms, basic spreadsheet copying.
mycol_evidence: WEF Future of Jobs Report: Rapid decline due to OCR and optical language models.

title: Contact Centre Call Handler (Tier 1 Routine Support)
description: Answers routine customer inquiries via telephone or basic messaging using canned scripts.
tasks: Reading predetermined scripts, logging basic support tickets, manual appointment booking, routing phone calls.
mycol_evidence: Widespread transition to AI conversational agents; urgent need for upskilling to AI interaction QA.
